data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Dalis is a name given to the sea nymphs or goddesses. They were believed to have the power to calm the stormy seas and protect sailors. The name Dalis is derived from the Greek word 'dallos' meaning 'sea' or 'delos' meaning 'visible.'
